dedupe_keys.name: loadcast synthetic multi carrier industrial energy demand profiles

description: The loadcast developer publishes a Python generator of synthetic heat, cooling and electricity demand for an industrial site. Zenodo archives version 0.1.0 under MIT and links a public repository. Its README shows annual energy, heat-to-cold ratio, electricity share, process class, cross-carrier correlation and carrier lag as inputs, returning 8,760 hourly or quarter-hourly heat, cold and electricity values. These profiles can supply coordinated multi-carrier loads to storage, district-energy or plant-electrification simulations when measured site data are unavailable. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this generator. A limitation is that simulated profiles reflect parameter choices and generic process classes, not measured operations of a particular factory. Reported correlations and lags should be checked after generation, especially for boundary conditions and seasonal regimes. The linked documentation shows an example but this review did not inspect unit tests or sample outputs. The archive was not downloaded, and no profile was generated.
